steps.text: Operation Defend Lungmen is complete. I repeat. Operation Defend Lungmen is complete.
Police officers are asked to inventory their equipment, report to their stations, and return to their squads within one business day.
Members of the L. G. D. are asked to rendezvous with their squads and proceed to the L. G. D. to await further orders.
I repeat....

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: What are you doing here?

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: ...And what's that look on your face?

steps.name: Swire
steps.text: Nothing. It's nothing.

steps.name: Swire
steps.text: Stop. Where are you going?

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: To see.

steps.name: Swire
steps.text: No need to look, I've checked, there's nothing there.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Is that right.

steps.name: Swire
steps.text: Ch'en, it's fine. The battle is over.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Out of the way please, Little Miss Swire.

steps.name: Swire
steps.text: You've stopped Reunion, and even the special forces!

steps.name: Swire
steps.text: You've exposed them all to the L. G. D., Rhodes Island, and even the Censor all at once!

steps.name: Swire
steps.text: You've stopped them!

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Get out of the way!

steps.name: Swire
steps.text: You've done a good enough job, worthy of the Special Inspection Unit Chief.

steps.name: Swire
steps.text: You can stop investigating! What more do you want to know? There's nothing more to know!

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: I need to know what's going on.

steps.name: Swire
steps.text: This business with the sewers? That's what you need to know about?

steps.name: Swire
steps.text: Now you've done all you can, take one more step and you're off to the other side of Lungmen!

steps.name: Swire
steps.text: We can totally improve the city. We can rebuild, we can go and clear out all that stuff from the bad old days!

steps.name: Swire
steps.text: But, Ch'en, don't go down there. Don't look!

steps.name: Swire
steps.text: Sense of justice, sense of duty, sense of belonging, you've nailed them all! And you looked great doing it!

steps.name: Swire
steps.text: Ah Ch'en!

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Get out of my way.

steps.name: Swire
steps.text: It's because you're like this that you can't look!

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Someone told you not to investigate the sewers, right?

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Someone said the same thing to me.

steps.name: Swire
steps.text: Then why do you keep investigating? No one wants you to see this, no one!

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: That's not true.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Lungmen wants me to see it. This is who I am. I have to see it.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Swire, don't make me draw my sword.

steps.name: Swire
steps.text: Ugh....

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: What's that smell?

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: This....

steps.name: L. G. D. Officer
steps.text: Ah, you're back.

steps.name: L. G. D. Officer
steps.text: Did you catch the enemy commander? The Infected known as Mephisto?

steps.name: L. G. D. Officer
steps.text: Huh.... What did you say? Is that a cooperative attitude...?

steps.name: L. G. D. Officer
steps.text: What's going on? Didn't you Rhodes Islanders go after him?

steps.name: L. G. D. Officer
steps.text: ...Can you give an accurate statement?

steps.name: L. G. D. Officer
steps.text: We need to report on it and if the enemy commander isn't dead...

steps.name: L. G. D. Officer
steps.text: Dead? How did he die?

steps.name: L. G. D. Officer
steps.text: Are you sure about that? Only crystalline death identification and autopsy can identify the Infected, Oripathy erases primary biological identifiers....

steps.name: L. G. D. Officer
steps.text: You don't understand any of this, do you?

steps.name: L. G. D. Officer
steps.text: Huh? Wait, where are you going? Who's that you're holding?

steps.name: L. G. D. Officer
steps.text: ...What the hell happened down there?

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: The remnants of Reunion's squad should have successfully retreated by now.

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: I don't know if this counts as the battle the white rabbit wanted.... Though I'm not sure she much cared about that in the end.

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: Regardless, she did it.

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: White rabbit... you were a stubborn one.

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: 'Nice win'? Win my ass.... If you weren't dying, we'd all be charming ice sculptures by now.

steps.name: GreyThroat
steps.text: You survived, didn't you? You also got valuable combat experience.

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: Experience like that only comes up later. But when someone dies in front of you, they never come back.

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: I could have saved her.

steps.name: GreyThroat
steps.text: Has Amiya already gone to see the head of Lungmen?

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: Yeah, probably. Just leave it to them, I don't care.

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: GreyThroat, give me a hand.

steps.name: GreyThroat
steps.text: Huh? Why?

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: Are you messing with me? Don't you see what's happening to me?

steps.name: GreyThroat
steps.text: Are you unable to stand? You look okay to me.

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: ...Operator GreyThroat, I kindly request that you help me up. I've lost a lot of blood and I'm hypothermic. I look intact but am, in fact, dying. Please assist me in returning to our vessel!

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: Okay, you know what? Never mind. I don't want to be a bother.

steps.name: GreyThroat
steps.text: Why?

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: Aren't you leaving Rhodes Island? No need to force yourself to work for Rhodes Island anymore.

steps.name: GreyThroat
steps.text: ...Why?

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: Huh?

steps.name: GreyThroat
steps.text: In that fight, I felt the pain of the Infected.

steps.name: GreyThroat
steps.text: It was even more frustrating and hopeless than what's going on around us.

steps.name: GreyThroat
steps.text: I understand the pain of the Infected and I think we can stop these things from happening.

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: I'm thinking you haven't seen enough tragedy. GreyThroat, let me ask you this: what's the difference between you and me?

steps.name: GreyThroat
steps.text: You're Infected?

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: If we died in that battle back there, what's the difference between regular you and Infected me? It's just a couple dead people.

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: Some people care whether they are Elders or Ancients, some care about the country they come from, some look at race, and others value wealth....

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: I'm Infected, but I've never given anyone the 'oh woe is me,' 'Infected people are so oppressed' crap. Nobody wants to hear it.

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: Pick out anybody here in the slums, Infected or uninfected, nobody wants to hear it.

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: The level of pain doesn't matter, I just wish we could look at the pain of the Infected.

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: 'Infected people are people too,' it's as simple as that. And I don't want people looking at me like a pitiful little animal, I'm out for an even look, on the level.

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: Massacres, segregation, imprisonment, hard labor, I've seen it all, but what can I do to see the end of them?

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: The white rabbit did what I never could.

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: She showed me a true death struggle.... The kind of terror she would show us even if there was only a fraction of a second left. That kind of fortitude is enough to transcend any identity.

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: If I were to go and fight Lungmen's soulless black raincoats right now, it'd be a walk in the park. Compared to the white rabbit, they're nothing.

steps.name: GreyThroat
steps.text: Really?

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: No. I told you already. I'm dying, GreyThroat.

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: But fighting to the death for what you believe in? That's a solid ending. Bottom of my bucket list.

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: ...Get a load of these two.

steps.name: GreyThroat
steps.text: Who?

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: Dr.{@nickname}  and Amiya.

steps.name: GreyThroat
steps.text: Where's the Doctor going?

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: Off to Rhodes Island to bury the white rabbit.

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: Well, it says burial, but it's really just disposing of the body to prevent her from crystallizing, dusting, and causing secondary infections. We Infected people deal with that all the time..

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: At least, as a Rhodes Island operator, I've come to trust the Doctor. GreyThroat, did you see the look in Dr.{@nickname}'s eyes?

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: It's those eyes, that's what makes me trust somebody like that.

steps.name: GreyThroat
steps.text: I saw it.

steps.name: GreyThroat
steps.text: ...I think it's still Amiya's eyes that are scarier though.

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: Because those two are headed in different directions.

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: Dr.{@nickname} is going to the Infected crematorium, and Amiya is off to Lungmen, to the new graveyard for the Infected.

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: I finally understand why Ace says Dr.{@nickname} is worth just as much as Amiya and Kal'tsit

steps.name: GreyThroat
steps.text: So where is Kal'tsit?

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: Kal'tsit's wherever she's supposed to be.

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: Okay, let's go. Since you're not going to leave Rhodes Island, I'm gonna ask you one more time: please help me up.

steps.name: GreyThroat
steps.text: Why don't you wait for the medics to get here?

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: Because I'm in real bad shape. Elite operators... gotta look tougher than this.

steps.name: GreyThroat
steps.text: ...You'd rather die than look uncool for a minute.

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: Why do you say things you know will hurt me...?

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: And do you know who's our support medic on this op? It's Gavial. That Gavial. She said she'd wash her hands and be right over!

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: How do you feel about getting my blood splashed in your face?

steps.name: GreyThroat
steps.text: Give me your hand.

steps.name: GreyThroat
steps.text: I don't like blood.

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: Then I suggest we walk a little faster...

steps.name: GreyThroat
steps.text: Right.

steps.name: GreyThroat
steps.text: If I hadn't saved those Infected children, you wouldn't have saved me, and I wouldn't have had a chance to change my mind about Infected people..

steps.name: GreyThroat
steps.text: That's another way the Infected have inspired me.

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: Huh?

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: ...You screwed it up again.

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: What does that have to do with me saving you?
Lungmen - Uptown - Chief Executive's Office

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Hello. I have an appointment with Mr. Wei. Can you take me in?

steps.name: Receptionist
steps.text: Ah, Chief Wei's last meeting just ended, please come this way, miss.

steps.name: Receptionist
steps.text: Um... You are...?

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Amiya. Amiya the Infected.

steps.name: Taihe
steps.text: With that, we take our leave.

steps.name: Elderly Male Voice
steps.text: Until next time.
What do you think?

steps.name: Taihe
steps.text: I have seen his brutal methods.

steps.name: Censor
steps.text: Business as usual on the surface. In truth, we all know.
People of his kind are always like that. I do understand why he is the one guarding Lungmen.
Infected? What are you doing here?

steps.name: Receptionist
steps.text: Ah, no offense intended. This is also a guest of Mr. Wei...

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: I'm not here to ask anything of Mr. Wei.

steps.name: Receptionist
steps.text: (Miss Amiya, at least do make yourself scarce for a moment...!)
Your clothes... they indicate you are of Rhodes Island, working with Lungmen.
The Infected should not stay long. Lungmen has been known to devour people.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Thanks for the tip. But this world isn't picky about who it eats.
Oh...
Then I should thank you for the warning.
Do you know who she is?

steps.name: Censor
steps.text: What are you plotting?

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Mr. Wei.

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: Oh.... Miss Amiya, I figured you'd come. The war was a success, and Rhodes Island deserves a lot of credit.

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: Next, Lungmen will fulfill her contractual obligation to provide Rhodes Island with necessary commercial assistance, among other things....

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: No thank you, Mr. Wei.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: I'm just here to cancel the contract.

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: I'm sorry?

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: Does Rhodes Island hate the old bait-and-switch so much? If there is any impropriety in what I have done, please, speak your mind.

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: I will offer my sincerest apologies, Miss Amiya

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Mr. Wei, you always act so polite and it leaves me a little overwhelmed.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: But I've seen your armed forces and your plans.

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: Don't read too much into the war, Miss Amiya. This isn't a charge, is it?

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: No, Mr. Wei. I have no power to charge you. I'm simply here to handle the post hoc formalities.

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: Why do you want to terminate our agreement?

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Because I have determined that a partnership with Lungmen is not a good fit for Rhodes Island.

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: Mutual benefit, isn't that good enough for a business enterprise?

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Even a business has its own development plan.

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: Are you implying that Lungmen owes something to the Infected side of your business?

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: No. Rhodes Island has never had an 'Infected' side.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Rhodes Island isn't just fighting for the Infected.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: I'm not just an Infected person.... I'm also a part of the global community.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Rhodes Island has such expertise in dealing with the Infected because many of our operators are themselves Infected and know the experiences and circumstances of the people.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: But trying to rid the land of the specter of Oripathy never meant that we were fighting only for the Infected.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Mr. Wei, if you think we are just a simple and naïve Infected rights organization with an armed detachment.... I would be very disappointed. A grave misunderstanding.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Rhodes Island fights for all the people of this world. You, us, and them.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Lungmen doesn't need our help. With the termination of this contract Rhodes Island will also leave Lungmen.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Rhodes Island has done its due diligence. It's all there in black and white. When we terminate the agreement, all the auxiliary clauses lose effect along with it.

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: Rhodes Island could take Lungmen's gracious bounty as a gift.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: No need, Mr. Wei. We in Rhodes Island are more interested in the way our partners do business than their 'bounty'.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Mr. Wei, you have treated us as a pawn in your game from the beginning. Now that the pawn has proven its worth, our exit should be in accordance with your plans.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: However, Mr. Wei...

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: Go on.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: If it was only Rhodes Island that was being played, I would not terminate this contract. As strange as it may sound, I can understand mutual distrust between partners.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: It's just that we're not the only ones that Lungmen is hiding the truth from.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: The L. G. D., the people of Lungmen, the Infected in the slums.... None of them know the shady methods hidden behind the curtain.

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: I've heard you can read minds, Miss Amiya.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: You may assume that I can't, or that I can.

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: Can I take your speculation as a warning, rather than an interrogation?

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: I'm not going to dictate Lungmen's strategy or future plans, Mr. Wei. But I have the power to prevent my operators from participating in them.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Mr. Wei, whether a Rhodes Island operator, a member of the Reunion Movement, an exile for Chernobog, or a citizen of Lungmen...

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: They are all living, breathing people. I don't think it's acceptable for their lives to be guided by secret machinations.

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: I, on the other hand, believe that playing a role is far more important than whether or not one recognizes that role.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: ...No. You're wrong.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Some things are... for Mr. Wei, perhaps too commonplace. Just like for the average person, quarantining an Infected person is an ordinary thing, not worth discussing.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: But, no matter how 'normal' it is, it should not be treated as a 'normal' thing.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Simply because something has happened to us enough times, we become accustomed to it, and that makes it acceptable...? That doesn't make sense.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Otherwise, even if we eradicate Oripathy, our conflicts will not diminish or die down.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: They will simply be reappropriated to imprison and torment another group of people... Just no longer the so-called 'Infected'.

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: Is this a request... Or simply an ideal?

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: This is my standard.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Mr. Wei, there is one more thing I must say.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: ——The living are not pawns. People are people.

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: Do you play chess, Miss Amiya?

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Mr. Wei...

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Do you play black, or white?

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Wei Yenwu, what have you done?!

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: Officer Ch'en, I have a guest.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Officer Ch'en?

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: What have you done?! Was it you?

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: No, it could only be you.... It can only be you.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: The rat and her cunning father are at best a little ruse. Only you would dare to order this.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: I had thought that by defeating Reunion, by reuniting all the people of Lungmen, we would eventually get through this. We could even bridge the misunderstandings between Lungmenites....

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: I never imagined... but I should have.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Once again you reassert yourself as the master of Lungmen. As you always were.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: But still.... How...? How could you do such a thing?

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: You tear down every obstacle? You burn everything in your path? To what do you finally bow your head?

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: I know how you all feel about the Infected. But why?! Why....? It's not just...

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: You don't even dare take responsibility for it.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Erase the name, erase the trail, erase the order, cover all your tracks.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Wei Yenwu, you and Lin should trade races.

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: You speak without thinking.

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: Superintendent Ch'en, I have no idea what you are referring to. I do hope your explanation is convincing.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Okay, I'll cut to the chase then.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Did you kill Talulah's father?

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: ...Officer Ch'en?

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Did you force our mother to marry that cowardly man?

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: Who put such thoughts in your head?

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: How about you take a guess?

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: Please watch your tone of voice.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Lord Wei, who controls everything in Lungmen, suddenly realizes that the secret he's been hiding for years has long since ceased to be a secret?

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: Officer Ch'en, know your place. Guards!

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: It was Talulah who told me.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Of course, everything Talulah knew, not many people knew in the first place.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: You're angry, because you know this could threaten your rule.... That old man, that Duke of Kashchey, has been in your nightmares from the very beginning.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: And you've never felt even a little bit sorry for Talulah, have you?

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: Officer Ch'en, don't speculate on facts you are not authorized to know, and don't trust information from unknown sources.

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: You're tired.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: I certainly don't trust that old duke! He almost destroyed all of Lungmen, and he's the one who kidnapped Talulah!

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: So...

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: But I remember it well.... It was a sunny day. That night, there was no moon, only a few stars.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: The old man grabs Talulah and stands on the other side of a broken bridge.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: And behind you....

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Behind you stands a crowd of people in black raincoats.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: I trust Talulah. I've always trusted her. I know she can be lied to as well, of course. But look at the kind of person you are!

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: You would sacrifice anything to get what you want!

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: Ch'en Hui-chieh!

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: You want to clean up the slums, even destroy them! So many Lungmenites, so many Lungmenites who trusted us, so many Lungmenites who stood behind us all along...

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Is it because the Infected don't count as citizens of Lungmen? Because they can't afford to live in your high-rises? Or is it because the people in the slums will one day live in peace with the Infected?

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Are you really protecting Lungmen? Aren't you the one who is a threat to this city and her people?

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Don't think you can throw a couple rats in front of you and get away with this!

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: The Lins wouldn't dare to do this without your permission!

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: Miss Ch'en.

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: You know nothing...

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: About what I've done for Lungmen.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: The thing that always annoyed me the most about you is this attitude you have, where you have to squeeze everything into your own grubby mitts.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: If the two of you could spare even a shred of free time, I'd like you to hear a message.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Dr. Kal'tsit?

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Take a look at your terminal. I sent the details over.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Ah.... okay.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: ...What?

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: I don't recall giving permission for you to enter my parlor, Dr. Rhodes Island.

steps.name: Fumizuki
steps.text: I let her in.

steps.name: Fumizuki
steps.text: After so many years have passed, why are you still like this....?

steps.name: Fumizuki
steps.text: Aren't you tired of hiding everything from her and doing it all yourself?

steps.name: Fumizuki
steps.text: Listen to our guest. We got the same message. You could have known three minutes earlier.

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: All right, Dr. Kal'tsit. Go ahead.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: The enemy's top commander was not present when we wiped out Reunion in Lungmen.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: This is simply because she was in Chernobog.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: She watched us, either calmly or with great consternation... But we paid her no attention at all.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: And now, a part of Chernobog, specifically its core...

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: ...is approaching Lungmen.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: In thirty-six hours, the urban core of Chernobog will collide with Lungmen.

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: That's a trifle. Lungmen has her ways to defend against nomadic cities and warships. A measly urban core is nothing to worry about. Why, we don't even have to....

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Are we on the same page, Chief Wei?

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: ...Has it started...

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Spamming out urban identification codes?

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: No.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Yes, your intuition, or presumption, is correct.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: The urban core has been beaming codes nonstop. All of Lungmen's subcities have already been hit.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: The codes claim——

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: 'This city belongs to Ursus.'
